name: Mirrored Picture Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material: Crafted with high-quality mirrored glass and a sturdy plastic or metal backing, ensuring durability and a premium reflective surface.

 

  • Product Sizes and Dimensions: 

- Frame edge options include stylish silver or gold finishes, each with a 1.2 cm thickness. 

- Available in various size options to suit different spaces:

         13×18 cm ~ 5.12×7.09 inches

         15×21 cm ~ 5.91×8.27 inches

         20×30 cm ~ 7.87×11.81 inches

         30×45 cm ~ 11.81×17.72 inches

         40×60 cm  ~ 15.75×23.62 inches

        50×75 cm  ~ 19.69×29.53 inches

        80×120 cm  ~ 31.50×47.24 inches

 

  • Printing Technology: Utilizes advanced UV printing technology, delivering sharp, vivid, and detailed images that resist fading over time.

 

  • Easy to Use:

- The 5.12×7.09 inches  and 5.91×8.27 inches sizes come with plastic easel  backs are made of plastic material, which is more durable than paper material, not easy to damage, and can be used as a desktop decoration.

- Larger sizes are equipped with sawtooth hangers for easy wall mounting.

 

  • Home Decoration: 

- Perfect for home decoration — can be placed on flat surfaces such as tables, shelves, and countertops, or hung on walls depending on the size and intended use. 

- Ideal for enhancing entryways, living rooms, bedrooms, hallways, or any space needing a touch of elegance and reflection.

 

  • Perfect Gift Ideal: An excellent gift choice suitable for everyone on any special occasion — birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, or holidays like Christmas and New Year's.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Mirrored Picture Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
